answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Video-call vouching with a verified human. It demands a live video call with a verified voucher, and the canyon is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the onyx compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the raven is that the farm's unit economics never work.
